study type: Observational comparative study (cross-sectional comparison of placental tissues)
exposure: incidence of common periodontal bacteria (Fusobacterium spp.) in placental tissues
cohort: The study included 29 control women with uncomplicated term births and 36 women with spontaneous preterm labour and delivery.
finding: The study found significantly more Fusobacterium spp. in the placentas from term births compared to preterm births.
gest_age: Preterm births were less than 34 weeks gestation, and controls were from term births.
